summary: Full e2e testing of Spynad agency landing page. All backend APIs and frontend flows tested and passing. 13 backend pytest tests passed. All frontend flows (hero, contact form, portfolio modal, admin login/dashboard/logout, unauthenticated redirect) working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py seed_admin does not update existing admin email if ADMIN_EMAIL env var changes — only password is updated. Low priority.
CORS allows '*' by default which may be too permissive for production — acceptable for preview env.
seed_data_creation: Test contacts created via POST /api/contact during testing (TEST_User, TEST_IDCheck, TEST_Delete, TEST John Doe). These persist in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All flows verified working. Backend: health, contact CRUD, admin login/auth, contacts list+delete. Frontend: hero CTAs, portfolio modal open/close, contact form submit+reset+toast, admin login with wrong/right creds, dashboard shows leads, logout redirects, unauthenticated /admin redirects to /admin/login. Resend email is intentionally MOCKED (skipped when RESEND_API_KEY empty).
mocked_apis: Resend email send — MOCKED, skipped because RESEND_API_KEY is empty in .env
